description: Detects regsvr32.exe spawned by an unusual parent process, which may indicate a LOLBin abuse technique.
queryCondition:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "regsvr32.exe"
| where not (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("msiexec.exe", "setup.exe"))
| where not (InitiatingProcessAccountName has_any ("svc-patching", "svc-deploy"))

detectionAction.recommendedActions: Investigate the process tree and parent process. Check if the regsvr32.exe call was initiated by a known software deployment tool.
